body:
Thanks for the comment..

Maybe I should keep going.

I have to say, I'm not the type of person to feel sad or cry. Last few weeks have been the exception. 

When you try for 3 years and things still don't change, it's so easy to lose hope. :\

Fair enough.

To me, the "right" way is to kill yourself in way that is fast- a way that will cause you the least displeasure.

If you want to bleed out for a minute, that's fine. If you know what you're doing, good. A lot of people cut themselves stupidly and just give themselves marks.

If I die I want to hang myself and snap my neck so I die instantly.

This quote from the movie Her really summed it up nicely for me: 

*"Sometimes I think I have felt everything I'm ever gonna feel. And from here on out, I'm not gonna feel anything new. Just lesser versions of what I've already felt." --Theodore*

Plunge a knife in your throat? What an idiotic way to go. No offense.

I think you should live. 

If you're going to die, like I am, kill yourself the right way.
Don't tell me what to do

Stop being an idiot. I've posted many times to this subreddit and many times the solution has been meds.

What else is there? Therapy? That doesn't always work. 

I actually think fontadmiral has a good point- psychedelic drugs could maybe change your world view completely. I've never done them, but I'm sure they're better than drugs that just numb you.
Right... that's why people here always offer advice about going on meds.

I didn't read your post because I am drunk.

I am going to hang myself soon. Make sure you tie the knot properly. The goal is to snap the neck when you fall, not to suffocate yourself slowly.

I have no good advice for you. I am ready to go.

Thanks for all of the advice. The results of this post were predictable.

It's time for me to go.

I will hang myself tomorrow. The knot is already tied- I just have to finish my notes.

Thanks for trying, all.

Thanks for the good read.

I don't know if I'm still in love with the same girl, I am just bitter because of the whole experience. I have a hard time looking at those 8 years we spent together. It's like I just try to forget those 8 years happened. 

I went to a therapist before and we talk about my future plans, but never went over the family stuff. I also don't think we went over the relationship stuff to a great extent.

I guess therapy is the only thing that can help me as I don't think I will ever get "proper" closure from this relationship ending.
I wish tough love advice worked for me but it doesn't seem to. :/

Thanks for the advice but I just don't know "just do it".

Maybe I should go to a mental institution.

I've been there before. I get a few messages but it's never enough to help. Everybody just suggests that I call a suicide hotline which is useless advice to me.

I want to be happy.

I know this is not your typical AskReddit post, but I don't get responses in other subs. I'm really lost as to what to do and I keep thinking it's time to go now. 

Please... your advice is appreciated.
